create_habitat_simulator_config: create a Habitat simulator configuration with RGB and depth camera sensors from a GLB scene path
place_agent_in_scene: place an agent at a specified position and orientation in the Habitat simulator scene
place_robot_from_agent: position a robot articulated object relative to the agent using local base position and orientation vector
create_habitat_manipulator_env: create a HabitatManipulatorEnv that loads a URDF robot into a Habitat scene with gravity compensation and joint damping
apply_joint_torques: apply joint torques to the robot and step the physics simulation forward by one timestep
